name: uniform-lab
description: 3D NFL uniform builder: mix helmets, jerseys, pants and socks for all 32 teams and stage matchups.

scripts.build:model: python3 tools/build_player.py --mh ${MAKEHUMAN_DATA:-/tmp/mh/makehuman/data} --out /tmp/uniformlab-model && gltf-transform meshopt /tmp/uniformlab-model/player.glb public/models/player.glb && cp /tmp/uniformlab-model/player.json public/models/
